name: M365 Group Naming Policy
description: Entra ID group naming policy format applied to Microsoft 365 groups (and therefore Teams). Prefix and suffix strings are restricted at policy creation; blocked words (list up to 5000) are rejected automatically.

fields.name: GroupName
fields.tip: Avoid emojis. Blocked words configured in the Entra naming policy are rejected automatically.

fields.name: Department
fields.tip: Supported Entra attributes: [Department] [Company] [Office] [StateOrProvince] [CountryOrRegion] [Title]. Real values resolve from your tenant's directory.
